title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 19.2 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 allowed authenticated users with a granular personal access token to gain Kubernetes API proxy access beyond their token's intended scope due to missing enforcement of granular scopes in the Kubernetes agent proxy-user authorization flow. This issue has been remediated by GitLab.
